summary: Comprehensive testing of attachment edit/rename feature completed. All backend tests (8/8) passed and all frontend functionality working correctly. Feature allows editing filename, tag, and notes for files in Labs & Imaging tab.
passed_tests: Edit button (pencil icon) appears next to each file bubble's timestamp in Labs & Imaging
Clicking edit opens inline edit form with teal border
Filename input is pre-filled with current filename
Tag dropdown is pre-filled with current tag
Notes input is pre-filled with current notes
Filename can be changed (renamed) and saved successfully
Tag can be changed via dropdown (lab/x-ray/ultrasound/ecg) and saved
Notes can be edited and saved
Cancel button closes the edit form without saving changes
Save button persists changes to backend
After save, toast notification shows 'File updated'
After save, the bubble shows the updated filename, tag, and notes
Backend validates empty update request returns 400
Data isolation: cannot edit another user's attachment (returns 404)
critical_code_review_comments: Edit form correctly replaces bubble inline with teal-bordered white card
All form fields have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Cancel properly resets state without saving
API correctly validates ownership before allowing edit (data isolation)
Error handling in place for empty updates (400) and not found (404)
seed_data_creation: Used existing test attachments from iteration 3. Temporarily modified one attachment for testing, then restored to original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit/rename feature for Labs & Imaging attachments fully tested. 8 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_attachment_edit.py cover PUT endpoint. Frontend Playwright tests verified inline edit form with filename/tag/notes fields, Cancel/Save buttons, and data persistence. data-testid patterns: lab-edit-{id} for edit button, lab-edit-form-{id} for form, lab-edit-filename-{id}, lab-edit-tag-{id}, lab-edit-notes-{id}, lab-edit-save-{id}.
